outcome: ICON (Indicator of Cardiac Output and Myocardial Contractility)
cohort: The study included 36 parturient women with severe preeclampsia who had recently undergone a cesarean section.
finding: Dexmedetomidine reduced cardiac output, heart rate, systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, and mean arterial pressure compared to saline in parturient women with severe preeclampsia after cesarean section, without affecting stroke volume or myocardial contractility.
